title: Everybody Thinks They’re Hot
origin: The artist replied “everybody thinks they’re hot” to a social post inviting people to share music they considered hot. The reply became the song title and hook.

versions.lyrics:
[Verse]
Everybody thinks they're hot
Ask 'em
Everyone's what you're not
Ask 'em
The whole room thinks they're top three
I look around, count the lies
Brush off the debris
Everybody thinks they're hot
Okay, okay, let it play, let it play
Everybody thinks they're hot
Okay, okay, let it play, let it play
[Verse 2]
Self-appointed, self-annointed, nah, scratch that introduction
You self-employed and selling bullshit, CEO of interruption
Loud commotion, empty ocean, promotion, I bet you just don't know shit
It counts beneath the post and all of them are getting powerhouse
Press kit and million-air rent, drew hundred-air
Numbers ain't everything until those fucking numbers there
Big announcements, big account and count the people clappin'
Underrated and discovered, they ain't ready for the vision
Funny how the whole department fits inside your kitchen
Everybody's competition, nobody will fucking listen
Nope, to the runny rappers in the comments, every one of them is pitchin'
That's why I'm bitching, goddamn man
[Outro]
Everybody thinks they're hot
Ask 'em
Everybody what you're not
Ask 'em
The whole damn room thinks they're top three
Everybody thinks they're hot
Okay, okay, let it play, let it play
[Verse]
Everybody thinks they're hot
